usage: In Cantonese, 架 (gaa3) is used to mean shelf or rack and usually follows a numeral classifier when counting or describing quantity.
The word 架 can refer to various types of shelves, such as bookshelves, shoe racks, or storage racks.
When describing location, 架 often appears before the specific item being stored, e.g., 書架 (book shelf).
架 can be used in both singular and plural contexts without changing form; context or classifiers clarify quantity.
架 is a common noun and often appears in everyday conversations about furniture or interior organization.

examples.meaning: This shelf is full of books.
